ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN base: a ka ɲi ka data tiɲɛnan ta, ka phase flow & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter cɛmancɛ k, p la; gnalenw 16 / 116 / 132 walima cycle 1072 tuma na a bɛ k*116 + p*16 baara kɛ k, p la walasa ka phase kelen ɲini, ka gnalenw cɛ ka ɲɛta n'a tun bɛ yen tun.
ui.tz_rule_mid: A bɛ taa rhythm 119 la (k*119 + jitter); ni gnalen ye 16 / 116 / 132 ye walima cycle 1072 (kɛw 14 tabɛ), a bɛ k*116 + p*16 baara kɛ k, p la walasa ka taa Phase A kelen na (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: A bɛ ɲɛna rhythm 119 kɔfɛ (k*119 + jitter); gnalenw 16 / 116 / 132 walima cycle 1072 (k*116 + p*16 k, p la), a bɛ phase minɛnna A2 / C7 bonya ani ka segin kɔfɛ n'data tun bɛ yen.
